title.en: Find the Days of Hangar Readings

brief.zh: 先在原表里找区域字段恰好写成 hangar 的记录，再把结果缩成日期和区域两列。
brief.en: Find raw rows whose area is written exactly as hangar, then show only the day and area columns.

concept.zh: 行筛选可以和选列一起做。文本比较区分大小写和空格。
concept.en: Combine row filtering with column selection. Text matching distinguishes letter case and spaces.

hints.zh: 原表写成 “ Hangar ” 的值带着空格和不同的大小写，在清洗前不会匹配。
hints.en: The raw value “ Hangar ” has extra spaces and a different case, so it will not match before cleaning.

label.en: Select Hangar rows and two columns

prompt.zh: 只留 zone 恰好为 hangar 的行，按顺序显示 day 和 zone。
prompt.en: Keep only rows whose zone is exactly hangar and show day and zone, in that order.
